title: Labour rights violations, exports and income per capita
title_zh: DP21765 劳动权利侵犯、出口与人均收入
authors: Céline Carrere, Marcelo Olarreaga, Camille Reverdy
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine how the impact of exports of goods and services on income per capita varies depending on the extent of labour rights violations in the export sector. In a sample of low- and middle-income countries, we find that specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations tends to reduce per capita income, due to lower productivity in those sectors. The negative impact of specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations is stronger in middle-income countries than in low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了商品与服务出口对人均收入的影响如何因出口部门劳动权益侵犯程度的不同而有所差异。基于中低收入国家样本，我们发现，专门从事劳动权益侵犯程度较高的部门往往会降低人均收入，其原因在于这些部门的生产率较低。相较于低收入国家，中等收入国家中专门从事高劳动权益侵犯部门所带来的负面效应更为显著。

title: Behavioral Biases are Temporally Stable
title_zh: 行为偏差具有时间稳定性
authors: Stango, Victor, Zinman, Jonathan
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Social scientists often consider temporal stability when assessing a construct and its measures, but whether behavioral biases display such stability is relatively unknown. We estimate stability for 17 biases, using lab-style elicitations in online surveys repeated three years apart. Biases are stable in the aggregate and at least moderately stable within-person. Within-person stability estimates tend to meet or exceed those for standard quantitative measures of patience and risk aversion, despite various pieces of evidence suggesting that classical measurement error substantially attenuates them. We consider implications for micro and macro modeling with potentially behavioral agents, and for survey and elicitation design.
abstract_zh: 社会科学家在评估构念及其测量时通常考虑时间稳定性，但行为偏差是否表现出这种稳定性尚不明确。我们利用相隔三年重复进行的在线调查中的实验室式诱发方法，估算了17种偏差的稳定性。这些偏差在总体层面具有稳定性，且在个体内部至少达到中等程度的稳定性。尽管多项证据表明经典测量误差会显著削弱个体内稳定性估计值，但其仍趋向于达到或超过耐心与风险规避的标准量化测量指标。我们探讨了这些发现对潜在行为主体参与的微观与宏观建模，以及调查与诱发设计的启示意义。

title: Determinants of Healthcare Provider Networks: Risk Selection vs. Administrative Costs
title_zh: 医疗提供者网络的决定因素：风险选择 vs. 行政成本
authors: Serna, Natalia
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper shows that health insurers’ decisions to include providers in their networks are influenced by a previously underappreciated source of cost savings: network administrative costs. These costs counteract insurers’ incentives to offer narrow networks, which in standard models arise from risk selection and negotiated prices. Using a structural model of insurer competition over network breadth applied to Colombia, I find that insurers engage in risk selection by excluding providers in services used by unprofitable patients, but that heterogeneity in administrative costs leads some insurers to offer broader networks. Results inform the design of risk adjustment and network adequacy policies.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，健康保险公司将医疗服务提供者纳入其网络的决定受到一个此前未被充分认识的成本节约来源的影响：网络行政成本。这些成本抵消了保险公司提供窄网络的激励——在标准模型中，这种激励源于风险选择和协商价格。通过将保险公司在网络广度上的竞争结构模型应用于哥伦比亚，我发现保险公司通过排除不盈利患者所使用服务的提供者来进行风险选择，但行政成本的异质性导致部分保险公司提供更广泛的网络。研究结果为风险调整和网络充分性政策的设计提供了参考。

title: The Uneven Impact of Industrial Zones on Formal Job Creation in Vietnam
title_zh: 越南工业区对正规就业创造的不均衡影响
authors: Brian McCaig, Margaret S. McMillan, Marina Mavungu Ngoma, Anh T. Pham
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Industrial zones are a widely used industrial policy tool, yet their effects vary enormously. Matching the timing and location of zone establishment to firm-level data in Vietnam, we estimate that a new zone raises formal employment by 2,000 workers within seven years. This average masks extreme skewness: a handful of zones generate the gains while the rest produce almost none. Zones near major trade hubs account for most of the effect, driven by export-oriented foreign manufacturers. Accounting for spillovers, domestic firms face agglomeration shadows nearby but gain farther out, while foreign manufacturers operate as enclaves, generating few local linkages.
abstract_zh: 工业区是一种广泛使用的产业政策工具，但其效果差异巨大。通过将越南工业区设立的时间与地点与企业层面数据进行匹配，我们估算出新建工业区在七年内可使正规就业增加2000人。这一平均值掩盖了极端偏态分布：少数工业区贡献了全部增长，其余工业区几乎毫无成效。靠近主要贸易枢纽的工业区贡献了大部分效应，其驱动力来自出口导向型外资制造商。考虑溢出效应后，国内企业在邻近区域面临集聚阴影，但在更远距离处获益；而外资制造商以飞地模式运营，几乎未产生本地关联。

title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
title_zh: 公共与私人医疗体系的选择：来自退伍军人的证据
authors: Marika Cabral, David C. Chan Jr, Seth Neller
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了老年退伍军人在公共与私营医疗体系之间的选择问题。这些退伍军人有资格通过公立的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）以及由医疗保险资助的私营医疗机构获得医疗服务。我们分析了在不同VA使用率地区间迁移的退伍军人的医疗体系选择，以量化个体特定因素（如偏好、收入、健康状况）和地区特定因素（如当地可及性、质量及便利性）的相对重要性。估算结果表明，VA使用的地理差异中50%–60%可归因于需求侧的个体因素，其余部分则由地区因素解释。我们还发现不同医疗类型之间存在显著异质性：地区因素对住院和急诊服务的影响大于对门诊和初级保健服务的影响。进一步分析表明，近期立法强调的供给侧特征——与VA机构的距离及等待时间——仅能解释地区效应的一小部分。这些发现凸显了个体因素在医疗体系选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA使用地理差异的政策具有启示意义。

authors: Wei Zhang, Jeffery Connor
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics

abstract: This special issue examines the economics of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation in agriculture. The papers in the issue study agricultural mitigation from three broad perspectives: the design of mitigation incentives, the economic benefits of mitigation practices and programmes, and the adoption and behavioural responses by producers, consumers and other stakeholders. The papers span a wide range of countries, production systems and policy contexts, and collectively show that translating mitigation potential into mitigation outcomes depends critically on incentive design, measurement and the actions across producers, consumers, regulators and supply‐chain actors.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本期特刊探讨农业领域温室气体减排的经济学问题。所收录论文从三大视角研究农业减排：减排激励机制设计、减排实践与项目的经济效益，以及生产者、消费者及其他利益相关方的采纳行为与响应。这些研究覆盖多个国家、生产体系及政策背景，共同表明：将减排潜力转化为实际减排成效，关键取决于激励机制设计、核算方法，以及生产者、消费者、监管机构和供应链参与者的协同行动。

title: Location Effects or Sorting? Evidence from Firm Relocation
title_zh: 区位效应还是分类效应？来自企业搬迁的证据
authors: Pauline Carry, Benny Kleinman, Elio Nimier-David
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What role do firms play in geographic wage disparities? This paper exploits establishment mobility as a novel source of identification to separate firm sorting from location treatment effects, i.e., the local wage premium for a given worker at a given firm (due to, e.g., geography, infrastructure, amenities). Using data from France and the U.S., we first document key facts about establishment relocation: 4% of establishments move each year, retaining their activity and structure while adjusting their workforce and wages. Combining establishment and worker mobility in France, we estimate a model that decomposes wage variation due to workers, firms, and locations. Spatial wage differences are primarily driven by sorting: worker composition accounts for 30%, firm composition for 17%, and their co-location for 34%. Residual location effects explain only 2–4%. Establishment sorting also accounts for most of the urban wage premium and the higher wage growth in larger cities.
abstract_zh: 企业在地区工资差异中扮演何种角色？本文利用企业迁移作为新的识别来源，将企业分类效应与区位处理效应（即给定工人和给定企业在特定地点获得的工资溢价，例如由地理、基础设施、便利设施等因素导致）分离开来。基于法国和美国的数据，我们首先记录了企业迁移的关键事实：每年有4%的企业迁移，它们在保留自身活动和结构的同时调整员工队伍和工资水平。结合法国企业和工人的流动性，我们估计了一个分解工人、企业和地点对工资变化影响的模型。空间工资差异主要由分类效应驱动：工人构成解释30%，企业构成解释17%，两者共同定位解释34%。残余的区位效应仅解释2-4%。企业分类效应还解释了大部分城市工资溢价以及大城市中更高的工资增长。

title: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
title_zh: 生产函数估计的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据
authors: Jose Miguel Abito, Konstantinos Metaxoglou
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a new approach to production function estimation that integrates the strengths of the proxy‐variable (PV) and dynamic panel data (DPD) methods. Our framework augments the set of instruments for the level equation in Blundell and Bond [8] with a Berkson‐type instrument motivated by economic theory, following Olley and Pakes [28], Levinsohn and Petrin [24], and Ackerberg et al. [4]. This modification allows unobserved productivity to include both a time‐invariant (“fixed‐effect”) component and a time‐varying component that follows a potentially nonlinear Markov process. Whereas the PV approach accommodates nonlinear Markov dynamics but not fixed effects, and the DPD approach accounts for fixed effects but only with linear Markov dynamics, our method relaxes both restrictions. Our estimator is straightforward to implement using GMM. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the canonical PV and DPD estimators when productivity persistence is low and fixed‐effect heterogeneity is substantial.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的生产函数估计方法，融合了代理变量法与动态面板数据法的优势。我们的框架在Blundell和Bond [8]的水平方程工具变量集中，引入了一个基于经济理论的Berkson型工具变量，遵循Olley和Pakes [28]、Levinsohn和Petrin [24]以及Ackerberg等人[4]的思路。这一改进允许不可观测的生产率同时包含时不变（“固定效应”）成分和遵循潜在非线性马尔可夫过程的时变成分。代理变量法虽能处理非线性马尔可夫动态但无法应对固定效应，动态面板数据法则能处理固定效应但仅适用于线性马尔可夫动态，而我们的方法同时放宽了这两项限制。该估计量可通过广义矩估计法简便实现。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当生产率持续性较低且固定效应异质性显著时，本方法优于经典代理变量法和动态面板数据法估计量。

title: Can Evidence-Based Information Shift Preferences Towards Trade Policy?
title_zh: 基于证据的信息能否改变人们对贸易政策的偏好？
authors: Alfaro, Laura, Chen, Maggie, Chor, Davin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Amid public skepticism toward trade, we investigate whether evidence-based information - concise statements of research findings - can shape trade policy preferences. In survey experiments conducted on U.S. general population samples from 2018-2022, we consistently uncover a “backfire effect”: information highlighting the benefits of trade, such as job gains in productive sectors or lower prices for consumers, induces protectionist preferences. We interpret this effect as stemming from prior-biased belief updating, whereby the information activates pre-existing concerns about competition for jobs and trade relations with China. These associations are evoked particularly among limited-attention respondents, as well as politically-engaged Republicans.
abstract_zh: 在公众对贸易持怀疑态度的背景下，我们探究基于证据的信息——即研究发现的简明陈述——能否影响贸易政策偏好。通过对2018-2022年美国普通人群样本进行的调查实验，我们一致发现了一种“反噬效应”：强调贸易益处（如生产性部门的就业增长或消费者价格降低）的信息，反而引发了保护主义偏好。我们将这一效应解释为源于先验偏误信念更新，即信息激活了关于就业竞争及对华贸易关系的既有担忧。这种关联在注意力有限的受访者以及政治参与度高的共和党人中尤为显著。

abstract: 在构建中国经济学自主知识体系中传承中华优秀传统文化是当前经济学理论创新的重大课题。中国古代经济思想的知识体系与现代西方经济学不同，它的重要特征是：国家本位和国家治理以及经济社会改革。它具有回应时代和历史需求的国家观念，所讨论和阐发的思想都是“国之大者”。土地制度、赋税制度以及租佃制度是中国封建社会的基本经济制度，也是千年经济思想史讨论的重大主题；农商关系的争论，实质上反映了中国古代思想家对封建社会...
